findings.message: Error message changed from 'page number must be >= 1' to 'page number must be positive'; while mathematically equivalent for integers, 'positive' may be ambiguous (some definitions include 0), so '>= 1' is more precise.
findings.suggestion: Revert to 'page number must be >= 1' for unambiguous clarity, or explicitly define 'positive' as '> 0' in documentation if intended.

findings.message: Loop condition uses <= which causes an off-by-one error, leading to an out-of-bounds slice access when i equals start+len(pageRows)
findings.suggestion: Change the loop condition from i <= start+len(pageRows) to i < start+len(pageRows)
